title: ScanCompletedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'scan.completed'. Emitted when a library scan job (docs/PLAN.md §8.1) finishes, successfully or not.

skippedUnsupportedCount.description: STATE.md H3: count of walked files whose extension is known-media-but-excluded-in-v1 (ape/wv/wma today). Authoritative even when skippedUnsupportedFiles was truncated.

skippedUnsupportedFiles.description: STATE.md H3: library-root-relative paths of skipped unsupported-format files, capped at 100 entries. skippedUnsupportedFiles.length < skippedUnsupportedCount implies truncation.
